tasks.title: Reorder categories
tasks.statement: Reorder the categories as low, high and print the sorted values.
tasks.solution:
import pandas as pd

s = pd.Series(pd.Categorical(["high", "low"], categories=["high", "low"], ordered=True))
print(s.cat.reorder_categories(["low", "high"]).sort_values().tolist())

tasks.title: Names for a MultiIndex
tasks.statement: Build a MultiIndex from the tuples with names and print them.
tasks.solution:
import pandas as pd

idx = pd.MultiIndex.from_tuples([("Pune", 2026)], names=["city", "year"])
print(list(idx.names))

tasks.title: Cross-section shape
tasks.statement: Take the cross-section for one city and print its length.
tasks.solution:
import pandas as pd

df = pd.DataFrame({"city": ["Pune", "Pune"], "year": [2025, 2026], "v": [1, 2]})
s = df.groupby(["city", "year"])["v"].sum()
print(len(s.xs("Pune", level="city")))

tasks.title: Pipe a lambda
tasks.statement: Add one to the values through pipe and print them.
tasks.solution:
import pandas as pd

print(pd.DataFrame({"v": [1, 2]}).pipe(lambda d: d.assign(v=d["v"] + 1))["v"].tolist())

debug.title: Codes read as if they started at one
debug.broken:

s = pd.Series(["a", "b"], dtype="category")
print(s.cat.codes.tolist())
debug.fix:

debug.error: Wrong output: [0, 1] — categorical codes are zero-based, so the first category is 0.

tasks.title: Z-score inside each group
tasks.statement: Standardise the values within each group and print the rounded result.
tasks.solution:
import pandas as pd

df = pd.DataFrame({"g": ["a", "a", "b"], "v": [1.0, 3.0, 10.0]})
z = df.groupby("g")["v"].transform(lambda x: (x - x.mean()) / x.std(ddof=0))
print(z.round(2).tolist())

tasks.title: Sort a report by rate

debug.title: A share printed without its denominator
debug.broken:

df = pd.DataFrame({"city": ["Pune", "Pune", "Delhi"], "passed": [True, False, True]})
print(df.groupby("city")["passed"].sum().to_dict())
